updates.content:
Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may be unable to view recent portions of their conversation history with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

User impact: Users may be unable to view recent portions of their conversation history with Copilot Chat.

More info: The affected conversations have not been deleted and are temporarily unavailable within conversation history. 

Some reports indicate that this issue typically occurs when users with an active Copilot Chat leave and then reopen the chat.

Current status: We're reviewing support cases to further our understanding of the current impact scenario and to determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and users are sporadically missing recent portions of their conversation history with Copilot Chat. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Next update by: Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 7:00 PM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to view recent portions of their conversation history with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

User impact: Users may be unable to view recent portions of their conversation history with Copilot Chat.

More info: The affected conversations have not been deleted and are temporarily unavailable within conversation history. 

Some reports indicate that this issue typically occurs when users with an active Copilot Chat leave and then reopen the chat.

Current status: Our review of support cases and service telemetry has identified an issue with how some Copilot Chat requests are directed to our service infrastructure. Requests from the same user can intermittently be sent to different parts of our infrastructure, so a conversation may sometimes load an earlier version of its history that doesn't include the latest exchanges. We're working to determine why these requests aren't being consistently directed, so that we can develop a fix that ensures users always see their complete conversation history.

Scope of impact: Some users are sporadically missing recent portions of their conversation history with Copilot Chat. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Next update by: Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC
